name: CubiFab C1
notes: Pre-launch: Kickstarter launch 'coming soon' (email sign-up only, first public demo at Maker Faire Bay Area Sep 2026). Price is the announced Super Early Bird 'starting from' USD 1,899; MSRP USD 2,999. Two versions: C1 250W (5,000-24,000 rpm) and C1 800W (9,000-18,000 rpm); values here are for the 250 W version, assumed to be the 'from' price (vendor does not map prices to versions). Working area with ATC installed; without ATC 300 x 200 x 150 mm. 14-tool ATC with RFID tool recognition, ER11 for 3.175/4/6 mm shanks. Tool probe (0.001 mm), 3D probe (<0.05 mm), 5 MP probing camera. x86 real-time controller. Optional rotary (cylindrical) machining. Maker: Cubivs Tech LLC.
